name: Shōwa (Yamanashi, Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Shōwa town emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised mountain of concentric arcs.
history: Municipal flag of Shōwa, a town in Yamanashi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1971.

features.role: Shōwa town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised mountain of concentric arcs
